purpose: Evidence-first review of the seven existing holdout event identities; this pass adds no event or predictor input.
selection_exposure: No E prediction or model output was read to select or exclude candidates.

protocol.basis: Main-agent-reviewed internal trajectory method supplement v13 plus the direct user deadline update.
protocol.windows: Cutoff UTC day D0 excluded; baseline D-7 through D-1; observation D+1 through D+7.
protocol.required_sources: Two independent, quantitatively comparable public-discussion source families; each source/window needs at least 6/7 valid days and at least 5 deduplicated primary units.
protocol.primary_unit: Distinct HN story submissions, deduplicated by normalized linked URL. Comments are not substituted into the primary-unit count after seeing results.
protocol.direction: Not assigned in this pre-screen. Zero/insufficient coverage, source conflict, and confounds remain unknown.
protocol.scope: Insurance events only for the formal insurance denominator.

source.version: Public Algolia historical search; exact query and UTC range are recorded per window. Retrieved bytes were hashed; provider completeness is not established.
source.filters: tags=story; one exact query per candidate and window; numeric created_at_i >= window start and < window end; hitsPerPage=1000. Each request covered one complete 7-day date range; individual per-day responses were not captured.
source.data_retained: HN story ID, created_at, public headline and linked publisher URL only; no usernames or raw author fields retained.
source.hash_interpretation: SHA-256 fixes the response bytes seen in this pass. It does not prove historical index completeness or independently reproduce provider coverage.
source.daily_coverage_note: The successful range query does not establish six valid daily captures. No candidate is credited with 6/7 daily coverage in this pass.

overall_result.reason: Seven existing v4 events and one Erie replacement lead were examined. No event met the primary-unit minimum in both windows; daily coverage was not verified as 6/7, and no second comparable public-discussion family was available. These are source-screen outcomes, not trend labels.
